gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (APPLY) for the visa took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'The application' = the act or form of applying; 'applicant' = the person.

gaps.sentence: The council rejected plans for a new ___ (DEVELOP).
gaps.explanation: 'A development' = a building project; 'developer' = the company.

gaps.sentence: The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.

gaps.sentence: ___ (PERSIST) rain ruined the first two days of the festival.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'rain': persistent; 'persistence' is the noun.
Negative prefix for 'legal' is 'il-' before l: illegal.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (IMPORTANT) of sleep is often ignored.
